title: Arik Armstead: Travis Hunter is the most talented athlete I've been around

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Arik Armstead: Travis Hunter is the most talented athlete I've been around
sources.description: Travis Hunter's rookie season came to an early end due to a knee injury, but one of the 2025 first-round pick's veteran teammates saw enough to know he believes the wide receiver/cornerback brings something special to the table.
